QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` builds with Clang MemorySanitizer. Secret inputs are marked uninitialised... `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` runs `make memcheck` on the same idea.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the MemSan/Valgrind testing, but it never says the facility is off by default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
